confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on four web searches. For inexpensive meals ($25, range $15-50), cappuccino (~$4.92-5.20) and domestic draft beer (~$6, range $3-9), I used aggregated cost-of-living figures from Numbeo via Expatica (June 2026), Expatarrivals (March 2026) and MyLifeElsewhere. I raised beer slightly to $7 for a July 2026 restaurant pour. The mid-range meal for two uses a Cities Insider dining table (~$100 before tax and tip). A Localite figure of ~$50 looked low or out of date, so I set it aside. For cocktails I combined Expatistan (~$17 downtown), Square menu-pricing averages (~$11-12) and Cities Insider ($14-17). I found no aggregated figure for a glass of wine, so I estimated it from the relationship to beer and cocktail prices; it is less certain. I did not search accommodation prices. The four accommodation anchors are my own estimates from general knowledge of Atlanta's small hostel market and its mid-range hotels in summer, so they are less certain, especially the hostel figures. Prices before sales tax and tip.
comparable_city_reasoning: Large US Sun Belt metro. Restaurant and bar prices are roughly at or slightly above the US average and below New York, Boston and San Francisco. Similar to Nashville, Charlotte, Houston or Dallas. Accommodation is benchmarked against similar mid-tier US convention and tourism cities in summer.
